snippet.title: Amazing Frog? Game Preview XBOX Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Amazing Frog? Grand Frog Auto Swindon, Jumps in to Game Preview on Xbox.
Amazing Frog?® is an open-world ragdoll sandbox like if GTA was set in Swindon and everyone was a farting frog. Explore alone or with up to 4 friends in split-screen chaos. Launch yourself out of cannons, steal blimps, drive scooters, and dive with sharks. Discover trophies, zombie sewers, and the Quest for the Magical Mystery Toilet. Unlock new worlds, costumes, vehicles, and tools as you collect, explore, and cause complete mayhem.
Explore. Collect Everything. Get a Job. Flush it. And Blow Sh*t Up. *Video is all live gameplay capture played on a  PC
